canonical_units.label: НЕ раздельно в словарно закреплённых кратких/предикативных формах
canonical_units.learner_policy: Teach the fixed separate spelling; do not force one part-of-speech label onto every member.

canonical_units.label: НЕ СОГЛАСЕН: отдельное написание как нормативный учебный ориентир
canonical_units.learner_policy: Use separate spelling as the current dictionary-backed learner default; do not infer a universal rule from the old textbook category label.

canonical_units.label: НЕ НАДО, НЕ ЖАЛЬ: раздельно
canonical_units.learner_policy: Do not label these forms as short adjectives.

canonical_units.label: НЕ НУЖНО / НЕНУЖНО: написание зависит от функции
canonical_units.learner_policy: In necessity/predicate meaning use НЕ НУЖНО separately. Do not ask the isolated string without syntax/meaning context.

ownership_rule: The old mixed source bucket school-ne-short-predicative-separate-set is not counted. Generic school-ne-adverbs-special-boundaries must not duplicate ownership of НЕ ЖАЛЬ, НЕ НАДО or predicate НЕ НУЖНО; provenance may remain, mastery identity does not.
